title: ロボティクス専門実験・演習A
subtitle: Robotics Major Lab/Exercises A
keywords: Electrical and electronic circuits 2.Vibration engineering 3.Control engineering 4.Robot control 5.Mechanics
educationalGoal: (1) Learn basic theory and method for robotics control. (2) Deepen understanding and develop robotics application capabilities. (3) Learn the skills needed to perform experiments and write reports. (4) Learn how to arrange and present the content, results, and discussion in a report.
advice: This is a course of lab exercises in robotics. We will cover the following topics: 1.Measurement and Signal processing: Evaluation of sensor characteristics This course deals with linearity, nonlinearity and hysteresis property in sensors, which can be evaluated with a potentiometer, a pressure conductive sensor and a phototransistor. Using the Arduino and the MATLAB & Simulink software, the data acquisition can be done interactively. 2.Experiment for mechanics of materials Students will measure the load and deformation of a robot arm, summarize the results as a mechanical model and evaluate the model by experiments. 3.Exercise for micro-controller Students will construct a timer interrupt program, ADC/DAC program, PWM control and encoder reading program, and I2C program using Arduino, and run each program using an actual circuit, motor, and sensor. 4.Experiment for control engineering Students will apply the classical control theory to DC servomotors using Arduino and a PC with MATLAB/Simulink software.

activityGoals.body: Complete lab exercises safely while following the prescribed steps.
Complete lab exercises proactively using on your knowledge of robotics.
Organize and discuss results using your knowledge of robotics.
Write and submit a report using the results, and explain the results orally.
